description: Create an unpublished OpenTrain job draft from a full job description/project brief or supported import payload. This is the primary MCP job-drafting workflow: OpenTrain parses the description into its structured job fields server-side. The response includes validation state; each missing field carries an "ask:" question to relay to the human, its type, allowed enum values, and the field name(s) to set via opentrain_update_job_draft_fields. Publish with opentrain_publish_job when the draft is publish ready. Before drafting, ask the human (never guess): pay type, pay range (minimum, maximum and target rate), number of hires, hours or labels per person or total volume, locations and English level, and for admin accounts the internal client and job name. Create ONE job per customer engagement covering labelers and reviewers/QC; describe the reviewer role and its rate in the same job. Give the human the reviewUrl: it opens the Review step, which lists anything left and holds the Publish button.

canonicalJob.description: Optional simple OpenTrain canonical job object. Uses format=opentrain_canonical.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional idempotency key. Reuse this key to avoid duplicate drafts on retry.

importPayload.description: Optional supported import payload to send directly to the import-first API, such as schema.org JSON-LD or feed-derived JSON.

jobDescription.description: Full plain-text job description or project brief. This is the primary V1 workflow.

title.description: Optional job title for plain-text imports; saved exactly as given (the parser does not rewrite it).

name: opentrain_create_job_draft
